parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Commence integration and reach $ax^3\ln x+b\int x^3(1/x)\,dx$. [*M1] Guidance: allow omission of $dx$.
Obtain $\frac13x^3\ln x-\frac13\int x^3(1/x)\,dx$. [A1 OE] Guidance: allow omission of $dx$.
Complete integration and obtain $\frac13x^3\ln x-\frac19x^3$. [A1] Guidance: allow $-\frac13(\frac13x^3)$.
Use limits correctly and equate to 4, having integrated twice. [DM1] Guidance: $\frac13a^3\ln a-\frac19a^3-(0-\frac19)=4$; allow one sign error or one numerical error; 0 may be absent or expressed as $\ln1$.
Obtain the given result $a=(35/(3\ln a-1))^{1/3}$ correctly. [A1 AG] Guidance: after substitution, any error even if corrected is A0; need at least one line of working between substitution and the given answer. Total: 5.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use $a_{n+1}=(35/(3\ln a_n-1))^{1/3}$ correctly at least twice. [M1]
Obtain $a=2.64$. [A1] Guidance: must be 2 decimal places.
Show sufficient iterations to 4 decimal places to justify 2.64, or show a sign change on $(2.635,2.645)$. [A1] Guidance: at 2.635, $(35/(3\ln a-1))^{1/3}-a=0.0029(4)>0$; at 2.645 the residual is $-0.012<0$. Total: 3.
